artifactsDescription: Update images this tenant has declared: firmware, software and configuration. An artifact is immutable once its content is uploaded.
searchLabel: Filter the artifacts on this page by name, version, component, token or digest
newArtifactDescription: Choose the file, describe it, and the console declares the artifact and uploads the content. The service checks the size and SHA-256 of what arrives.
emptyArtifacts: No artifacts match. Declare one with New artifact.
noMatchOnPage: Nothing on this page matches the filter. The filter narrows the loaded page only; use Next to look further.
hashFailed: The browser could not read this file to compute its SHA-256, so nothing was sent. A very large file may not fit in the browser's memory. ({{error}})
limitUnknown: The size limit for artifacts could not be read, so no file can be accepted. Reload and try again.
fileTooLarge: This file is {{size}}, over the {{max}} this instance accepts. Nothing was declared or uploaded.
fieldVersionHelp: A label the platform does not interpret. Name, component and version together must be unique.
fieldComponentHelp: The part of the device this updates, for example firmware or app/agent.
fieldProfilesHelp: The artifact can only be assigned to devices on these profiles. Choose at least one.
declaredNotUploaded: The artifact is declared but its content is not stored yet. Retry the upload, or open the artifact and upload from its page.
verifyFailedTitle: The service's answer does not match the declaration
verifyFailedBody: Do not trust this content. The artifact stays unavailable; check the file and upload again.
retireConfirmBody: A retired artifact is withdrawn from new use. Its metadata and content remain, and retiring cannot be undone.
uploadContentBody: This artifact is declared but has no stored content. Choose the file declared for it.
uploadSizeMismatch: This file is {{size}} bytes; the artifact declares {{declared}}. Nothing was uploaded.
uploadDigestMismatch: This file's SHA-256 is not the artifact's declared digest. Nothing was uploaded.
signaturesDescription: Trust is worked out each time the artifact is read, from the signatures on record and the state of the signers behind them.
trustSignedExplain: At least one active signer has a verified signature on this artifact.
trustUnverifiedExplain: No active signer has a verified signature. The platform checks the bytes are the declared bytes, and does not say who made them.
noSignatures: No signatures are recorded for this artifact. It stays unverified until a registered signer signs it.
signaturesRefreshFailed: The signatures could not be refreshed: {{error}}
fieldSignerKeyIdHelp: The key ID of a registered signer, listed on the Signers page, or printed by your signing tooling.
fieldSignatureHelp: The signature over this artifact's digest. Ed25519 signs the 32 raw digest bytes; ECDSA P-256 matches cosign sign-blob.
signersUnreadable: The registered signers could not be read, so the key ID cannot be checked: {{error}}
signerNotFound: No registered signer has this key ID.
signerNotFoundTruncated: No signer among those loaded has this key ID, and the registry is larger than what was loaded.
signerIsRevoked: This signer is revoked; its signatures no longer count.
signatureVerifiedByService: The service verifies the signature against the artifact's stored digest and refuses one that does not verify.
unverifiedBlocked: This instance does not allow unverified artifacts to be assigned, so this one cannot be assigned to a device until it is signed.
unverifiedAllowed: This instance allows unverified artifacts to be assigned. That is a development setting; do not rely on it in production.
unverifiedPolicyUnknown: The instance's policy on unverified artifacts could not be read. Assume this artifact cannot be assigned until it is signed.
unverifiedHowTo: Register your signing key, sign the artifact's digest and attach the signature below. See
